screen.scope: synthetic component test, not network RPC: identical temporary public constructor appended to both request modules and re-exported from lib; Call poll/drop source otherwise pinned. A boxed arithmetic future performs four wrapping multiply/rotate/xor rounds with black_box and always returns Pending or Ready. No per-poll measurement counters or allocation instrumentation. Pending and repollable Ready cases use one Call for 10 million polls after 20k warmups; first-Ready polls 250k preconstructed calls once, with construction outside timing. Repolling a completed real RPC is not recommended; that case deliberately uses a repollable synthetic future. Each poll result is validated in timing. Ten ABBA/BAAB blocks and same-binary controls, process CPU on one CPU of a shared runner.
